headline: DBM Releases ₱1 Billion for AI-Powered Flood Forecasting Across Major River Basins
seoTitle: DBM Releases ₱1B for AI Flood Forecasting | FMB News
seoDescription: An approved FMB News brief reports a ₱1-billion DBM release for AI-assisted flood forecasting and telemetry across 18 major Philippine river basins.
deck: The approved newsroom brief says the funding will support AI hydrological modeling and real-time telemetry across 18 major river basins.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News morning brief reports that the Department of Budget and Management released ₱1 billion for an AI-assisted flood forecasting and telemetry modernization program involving DOST and PAGASA.
The brief says the project is intended to cover 18 major river basins and combine hydrological modeling with real-time water-level, rainfall and terrain data.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The program is presented as a digital complement to structural flood-control measures, designed to give downstream communities earlier and more localized warning of possible inundation.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Earlier, location-specific flood forecasts can give local governments more time to warn residents, move vulnerable people and assets, and prepare evacuation and traffic measures before rivers overtop.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch DBM, DOST and PAGASA for the formal release documents, implementation timetable, procurement details and basin-by-basin deployment schedule.
